title: Repair-worker (self-repair) return
description: Return shape for a self-repair worker scoped to one spec file. Serves both fronts of the self-repair entrypoint: the Agent-subagent return in interactive mode, and the JSON report a `claude -p` worker subprocess writes to disk in script mode (the CLI driver validates it with this same schema).

file.description: The one spec file this worker was scoped to.

tests.description: One entry per test the worker was briefed on. No silent drops — every briefed test must appear.

fix.description: What was changed (selector, wait, state isolation) when outcome is healed.

understanding.description: Stage-5 understanding: the causal chain established by the experiment stage, in one or a few sentences. Recommended for every non-green outcome.

expected-behaviour.description: What the journey should do at the failure point.

actual-behaviour.description: What the app demonstrably does, per the evidence.

confidence.description: App-bug outcomes require high — mechanism demonstrated and test-side causes excluded by experiment.

evidence.description: Paths to the evidence bundle backing the app-bug classification — failure screenshot, error context/trace, failing-run video, and a slow-motion reproduction recording. Paths point at the stable <e2e-root>/bug-evidence/<TEST-ID>/ copies, never at reusable test-results/ dirs.

stage-log.description: Per-stage progress announcements — the structured mirror of the worker's `[self-repair:worker] stage=…` lines.

observations.description: Anything worth surfacing in the session report that isn't a per-test outcome (systemic debt, shared-fixture smells, app oddities).
